name: SlideTransition
desc: A subclass of AnimatedWidget, using an animator of type Offset to allow child components to transition between two Offset objects.

fields.name: textDirection
fields.desc: The direction to use for the x offset described by the [position].

fields.name: transformHitTests
fields.desc: Whether hit testing should be affected by the slide animation.

fields.name: child
fields.desc: The widget below this widget in the tree.
